assets.title: Scalloped-Cavity Mooncake Mould Paddle
assets.description: One original complete static Mid-Autumn Festival mooncake-mould-inspired wooden paddle. A thick square mould head has a genuinely recessed eight-scallop cavity, a complete thick floor and full interior walls. A separate raised eight-petal die relief rests on the whole finite cavity floor. A tapered fixed handle has a genuine through hanging aperture and a complete finite end-face joint to the head. Three complete editable closed meshes and three opaque constant untextured PBR wood tones. Metres, native Z up, cavity facing +Z, presentation front -Y and horizontal bounds-centred ground origin. The entire broad head underside is grounded, with real air beneath the raised handle. Every numeric model shape is newly authored; no old mooncake, cutting board, baking peel, bowl, relief, stamp, tray or imported geometry is copied, scaled, recoloured or combined. One complete prop and zero scenes. No mooncake food, dough, utensil set, text, logo, texture, person, motion or surrounding scene. Static stylized game-art appearance only: no historical reconstruction, regional or cultural authenticity, working pressing or release mechanism, mould fit, recipe, ingredients, food-contact suitability, hygiene, cooking, handling, load, stability, manufacture, installation or safety certification. Dimensions describe game-space geometry only.

assets.title: Fixed Tapered-Leg Balance Beam
assets.description: One original complete static gymnastics balance-beam visual prop. A continuous long narrow chamfer-ended beam has a true octagonal transverse section, an uninterrupted slim upper face, sloped shoulders and a broad flat underside. Two original tapered rectangular support columns meet its underside at separate finite complete seats. Each column stands on a separate transverse chamfer-corner foot with a broad continuous ground sole. Five editable closed connected meshes, four opaque constant untextured PBR materials. Metres, native Z up, long axis X, presentation front -Y and horizontal bounds-centred ground datum. Newly authored numeric geometry; no previous pommel-horse body, bench, hurdle, slant board, bleacher, platform, rack or imported model fragments. One complete prop and zero scenes. No pommels, climbing steps, athlete, mat, text, logo, texture, motion, surrounding gym or competition venue. Fixed stylized game-art appearance only: no gymnastics technique or instruction, athlete suitability, human fit, competition dimensions or standard, event affiliation, loading, stability, anti-tip, grip, material or padding behavior, adjustment mechanism, manufacture, installation, compatibility or safety certification. Dimensions are game-space proportions only.
